key_decisions: MPI-450 IS the pre-release. This project has one GitHub-only release flow and no pre-release tier, so the umbrella is the gate list rather than a release channel.

MPI-420: the card's stated premise was WRONG and it changed the whole fix. A missing TAESD decoder does not remove previews - latent_preview.py falls back to Latent2RGB, the blocky colour blob. Verified in the SHIPPED 0.29.2 engine, not the bench.

MPI-420: Krea 2 is NOT Flux-latent. comfy/supported_models.py has 'class Krea2 ... latent_format = latent_formats.Wan21', as do both Qwen models. Read the latent format out of supported_models.py, never off a model's transformer lineage. I got this wrong once and shipped it in a doc table before the user caught it.

MPI-420: lighttaew2_2 was shipped and then REVERTED the same session. ComfyUI issue #13366 makes the previewer corrupt the real generation latent mid-sampling on the Wan21/Wan22/Qwen family. Re-checked upstream 2026-08-05 via gh api: issue OPEN, fix PR #13383 UNMERGED, both untouched since April. docs/models/krea2/preview-taesd.md had already recorded this decision.

MPI-453: gate the mechanism, do NOT split Wan 2.2 into two Library entries. Per-op deps are the deliberate design and MPI-449's MiniMax H3 is the next consumer (one weight set for i2v + t2v, a second for ref2v). Splitting would mean deleting operations[].deps, deriveInstalledOps, the op-draft store and the Model Manager UI as DEAD CODE, then needing the same mechanism one release later.
Gate B runs AFTER the version bump and build on purpose: MPI-249 tests the ARTIFACT, and verifying a dev checkout does not verify a build.
constraints: MPI-404 IS BLOCKED ON THE USER and the question was asked but never answered. It is: when someone skips the local engine install and points at a models folder, the home hero reads MODELS 0 / 18 because the models root lives INSIDE the engine (extra_model_paths.yaml, written by routes/engine.js during provisioning). Is the models-root choice an APP-LEVEL setting that outlives the engine (the real fix, bigger change), or does it stay ENGINE-OWNED and the hero simply must not claim a count it cannot have (honest, small)? Ask before writing code.

NEVER add a dep whose filename starts with lighttaew - ComfyUI #13366. A test in tests/remote-engine-assets.test.cjs now fails on it. The bytes ARE staged on R2 at vision/models/vae_approx/lighttaew2_2.safetensors so that re-adding the dep is the whole job the day PR #13383 lands in our engine version. A downloaded copy was deleted from the user's models root (G:/CubricModels/vae_approx/) because the file ON DISK is what arms the bug, not the dep entry.

A peer agent is committing into this tree LIVE (it created MPI-451 and MPI-452 for the MiniMax H3 work mid-session, and edited MPI-449 twice). board.json and .agents/mpi-kanban/events.jsonl are co-owned: re-status right before committing and commit only your own paths. Both are currently uncommitted on purpose.

Board timestamps are AHEAD of the real clock (peer sessions on a VPN exit node). The real UTC time was ~04:00Z while board stamps read 10:30Z. Do not 'correct' a peer timestamp and never regress board.json updated_at - keep stamping forward from the highest value present.

Every card move must create the files its links declare, and validate_board.py PASSES in this repo - a non-zero exit is your own violation. Run it as 'validate_board.py .' from the REPO ROOT (passing the kanban dir is a false pass at exit 0) and never through a pipe.
